info.name: Vendor App API (Production - Hostinger)
info.description:
Complete production API collection for Vendor App running on Hostinger (https://knowlipop.shop).
Includes automatic dynamic registration, JWT Bearer token capture on Login & Register, full product CRUD, password reset OTP flows, seller bank onboarding, and Admin endpoints.

item.name: 6. Password Reset Flow (Firebase Email or Phone)

request.description: Sends password reset OTP via Firebase Phone Gateway (or Fast2SMS). Accepts phone, email, or unified identifier. In dev/testing mode, dev_otp is saved to {{otp_code}}.
Triggers Firebase Email Password Reset Gateway (sendOobCode) and stores hashed OTP. Also accepts single-field identifier or email_or_phone.
Verifies OTP code, Firebase id_token, or Firebase email oob_code for either email or phone, returning reset_token.
Sets new password for email or phone user using verified reset_token (or direct Firebase oob_code / id_token) and bumps token_version.
